note: The module has no configure route, no settings form, no permission of its own, no Drush and no plugins. Its entire persistent state is two third-party settings on the block config entity: block.block.<id> -> third_party_settings.block_aria_landmark_roles.role (constrained by schema to none|application|banner|complementary|contentinfo|form|main|navigation|search) and .label. hook_preprocess_block() turns them into $variables['attributes']['role'] (skipped for 'none'/empty) and ['aria-label']. All medium/hard cases are therefore grounded in real block config on the live site; the default theme here is olivero (regions include sidebar and footer_bottom).

evals.prompt: Which ARIA landmark roles can the Drupal contrib module block_aria_landmark_roles assign to a block, and what happens if I leave the selector on '- None -'?
evals.expected_output: application, banner, complementary, contentinfo, form, main, navigation and search (plus the '- None -' option, stored as 'none'). With 'none' — or no value at all — block_aria_landmark_roles_preprocess_block() does not add a role attribute to the block.

evals.prompt: Where does the Drupal block_aria_landmark_roles module store the landmark role and label for a block? There is no settings page for the module — give the exact config path.
evals.expected_output: On the block config entity itself: block.block.<block_id> -> third_party_settings.block_aria_landmark_roles.role and .label, set from the block configuration form (/admin/structure/block/manage/<id>) or with $block->setThirdPartySetting('block_aria_landmark_roles', 'role', 'navigation'). The module declares configure: null and has no settings form.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal block_aria_landmark_roles module actually get the role and aria-label onto the rendered block markup?
evals.expected_output: block_aria_landmark_roles_preprocess_block() loads the Block entity for $variables['elements']['#id'], and sets $variables['attributes']['role'] (only when the stored role is non-empty and not 'none') and $variables['attributes']['aria-label'] from the stored label — so the attributes appear wherever the theme's block.html.twig prints {{ attributes }}.

evals.prompt: One block on this Drupal site has been given an ARIA landmark role with the block_aria_landmark_roles module. Inspect the live block configuration and report which landmark role and which ARIA label it carries.
evals.expected_output: block.block.barl_eval_block (Olivero, sidebar region) has third_party_settings.block_aria_landmark_roles.role = complementary and .label = 'Site extras'.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has two blocks whose ids start with barl_eval_ and both have block_aria_landmark_roles settings saved. Inspect the live configuration and say which of them will actually render a role attribute on its markup, and why the other one will not.
evals.expected_output: barl_eval_on renders role="banner". barl_eval_off has role stored as the literal string 'none', and block_aria_landmark_roles_preprocess_block() only sets the attribute when the role is non-empty AND not 'none', so it renders no role (it still gets aria-label="Nothing special").

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a main menu block placed in Olivero with the machine id barl_task_menu. Screen-reader users cannot find it as a landmark. Using the block_aria_landmark_roles module, give that block the navigation landmark role and the accessible label 'Primary navigation'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: block.block.barl_task_menu gains third_party_settings.block_aria_landmark_roles.role = navigation and .label = 'Primary navigation' (block configuration form, or $block->setThirdPartySetting(...) + save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place the core 'Powered by Drupal' block (plugin system_powered_by_block) with the machine id barl_task_footer in the Olivero theme's footer_bottom region, and use the block_aria_landmark_roles module to give it the contentinfo landmark role and the ARIA label 'Site information'. Apply everything to the live site.
evals.expected_output: block.block.barl_task_footer with plugin system_powered_by_block, theme olivero, region footer_bottom and third_party_settings.block_aria_landmark_roles.role = contentinfo, .label = 'Site information'.
